facts.statement: Jiuquanornis is classified as a basal ornithuromorph dinosaur.
facts.quote: Jiuquanornis is an extinct genus of basal ornithuromorph dinosaur

facts.statement: The genus was first named by Wang, O'Connor, Li, and You in 2013.
facts.quote: Jiuquanornis was first named by Ya-Ming Wang, Jingmai K. O'Connor, Da-Qing Li and Hai-Lu You in 2013

facts.statement: Fossils are found in the Early Cretaceous Xiagou Formation of the Changma Basin in Gansu Province, northwestern China.
facts.quote: known from the Early Cretaceous Xiagou Formation of Changma Basin, Gansu Province of northwestern China

facts.statement: The animal lived between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago during the Aptian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: Only one fossil occurrence of this genus has been recorded.
